description: §42.4: a `?{}` row whose type the compiler cannot resolve is E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN as a bare condition (write `r is given`).
rationale: §42.4 statement 5: "a value that crosses the JavaScript boundary with no scrml type (§42.9) … SHALL be compile error **E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN**". Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a′, go" (supersedes S440 Truthiness Q2 for conditions; keeps S440 #4 = (c), Q1, Gotcha Q2, S442).
